mainEntity.name: Why does renewal eligibility matter at the renewal stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because timing often changes what can be done immediately, what must wait, and what becomes risky if a date is missed. Before the next step, renewal eligibility usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.
